spec_clauses.text: Concrete slab: grade C25/30, 150 mm thick, on compacted granular base. Clause 3.2 of the structural specification.
Reinforcement: deformed steel rebar, 85 kg per cubic metre of concrete, laps 600 mm minimum. Clause 3.4.
Masonry walls: clay bricks, 50 bricks per square metre of wall, mortar mix 1:4 cement:sand. Clause 4.1.
Floor finishes: ceramic tiles to bathroom and kitchen, 28 square metres, adhesive bed 3 mm. Clause 5.2.
Roof framing: softwood timber, grade C24, 120 linear metres of joists and rafters. Clause 6.1.
Fixtures: 12 plumbing and lighting fixtures as scheduled on sheet A-101. Clause 7.3.
